title: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks
slides: Can AI data centers derail the UN climate talks?
Negotiators weigh emissions from a booming industry
But those same data centers could power clean grids
Your energy bills may rise before any treaty lands
Ask one AI firm: how much water does it use?
thread_text:
1. The AI energy bill nobody voted for

UN climate negotiators are now debating emissions from AI data centers. Meanwhile, those same facilities could delay grid upgrades your household pays for.

2. Two-faced data centers

They could power clean grids with flexible demand. But the upside only arrives if operators share real numbers — and right now most don't.

3. The treaty won't lower your bill

Energy costs will rise before any climate agreement lands. The data center boom is already driving up local utility rates in some regions.

4. Water is the hidden cost

Cooling AI servers consumes millions of gallons daily. Ask one AI firm how much water it uses — most won't give a straight answer.

5. Check your utility's next rate case

Look up the next public hearing on data center power requests in your area. If you haven't done it, start there.
